description: This file defines an Android activity 'LceDemoActivity' that demonstrates network bandwidth monitoring using ConnectivityManager. It registers a network callback to receive updates on network capabilities and provides a button to trigger bandwidth updates for all available networks.

classes.name: LceDemoActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating network bandwidth callbacks and interactions with ConnectivityManager.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the user interface, registers network callback, and sets button actions.
